previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with type 1 diabetes, end-stage renal disease on dialysis, diastolic heart failure, and a history of drug-resistant UTIs was admitted for pyelonephritis and hyperglycemia. She presented with left flank pain, dysuria, and a blood glucose over 500. Urine culture grew Klebsiella pneumoniae resistant to multiple antibiotics, prompting a switch from Zosyn to meropenem. A PICC line was placed to complete a 14-day course of IV antibiotics at home. Her insulin regimen was optimized with an increase in morning NPH to 30 units and a revised sliding scale to prevent hypoglycemia. She was discharged home with services for IV antibiotic administration and daily straight catheterization to prevent urinary retention and recurrent infections.

the ED as noted by her ___.  Patient did not feel particularly

antibiotics with Vancomycin (at HD), Cefepime and Flagyl.

vascular surgery follow up, and anticipation of scheduled 
readmission within ___ weeks for definitive surgery.

admission and received 10u regular insulin in the ED as well as 
500cc NS.  She was then restarted on her home insulin regimen 
and blood sugars were well controlled without further issue.  On 
initial presentation she was noted to have oral thrush but 
denied any odynophagia or dysphagia.  This was likely from 
recent antibiotic course and poorly controlled DM.  She was 
given Nystatin swish and swallow prn.

 She was put transiently on Metoprolol instead of Carvedilol

of her CAD. 

#pAF: No longer on Warfarin given concern for calciphylaxis.

regular rhythm this admission but no EKG performed.  Given high

#Pain/Neuropathy:  Patient continued Gabapentin, tylenol and 
received additional Dilaudid prn for dressing changes and 
breakthrough pain.

___ and positive on ___.  SRA was negative on ___ 
which was in appropriate window to rule out HIT.  Regardless of 
this negative HIT work up for HIT, patient notes nausea, 
vomiting and rash with heparin injections and refused any 
prophylactic heparin administration.  She was maintained on 
Pneumoboots for DVT prophylaxis.
